name: buzzjs-demo
description: Buzz, a Javascript HTML5 Audio library - Demo
author: Jay Salvat

scripts.dev: mkdir -p dist && cp -r src/img dist/ && cp -r src/sounds dist/ && parcel src/index.html --port 3000
scripts.build: parcel build src/index.html --no-content-hash && cp -r src/img dist/ && cp -r src/sounds dist/ && cp src/humans.txt dist/
